// Source oracle extension; copy into the pinned PD metrics package.
package metrics

import (
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	rg "github.com/tikv/pd/client/resource_group/controller/metrics"
	"testing"
)

func TestRustParityInitializationLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	savedRegisterer, savedGatherer := prometheus.DefaultRegisterer, prometheus.DefaultGatherer
	registry := prometheus.NewRegistry()
	prometheus.DefaultRegisterer, prometheus.DefaultGatherer = registry, registry
	defer func() { prometheus.DefaultRegisterer, prometheus.DefaultGatherer = savedRegisterer, savedGatherer }()
	initialized = 0
	initMetrics(nil)
	initLabelValues()
	old := CircuitBreakerCounters
	var bound []prometheus.Counter
	RegisterConsumer(func() {
		families, err := registry.Gather()
		if err != nil || len(families) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("consumer must run before registration", err)
		}
		bound = append(bound, CircuitBreakerCounters.WithLabelValues("same", "success"))
	})
	if len(bound) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("initial consumer call")
	}
	bound[0].Inc()
	InitAndRegisterMetrics(prometheus.Labels{"cluster": "first"})
	if len(bound) != 2 || old == CircuitBreakerCounters {
		t.Fatal("must rebind")
	}
	current := CircuitBreakerCounters
	InitAndRegisterMetrics(prometheus.Labels{"cluster": "ignored"})
	if current != CircuitBreakerCounters || len(bound) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("once guard")
	}
	calls := 0
	RegisterConsumer(func() { calls++ })
	if calls != 1 {
		t.Fatal("late consumer")
	}
	OngoingRequestCountGauge.WithLabelValues("stream").Set(1)
	EstimateTSOLatencyGauge.WithLabelValues("stream").Set(2)
	families, err := registry.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	foundEstimate := false
	for _, family := range families {
		if family.GetName() == "pd_client_request_ongoing_requests_count" {
			t.Fatal("source does not register ongoing gauge")
		}
		if family.GetName() == "pd_client_request_estimate_tso_latency" {
			foundEstimate = true
		}
		for _, metric := range family.GetMetric() {
			found := false
			for _, label := range metric.GetLabel() {
				if label.GetName() == "cluster" && label.GetValue() == "first" {
					found = true
				}
			}
			if !found {
				t.Fatal("first labels not preserved")
			}
		}
	}
	if !foundEstimate {
		t.Fatal("estimate gauge missing")
	}
	oldResource := rg.TokenRequestDuration
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() == nil {
				t.Error("resource package must fail duplicate registration")
			}
		}()
		rg.InitAndRegisterMetrics(prometheus.Labels{"cluster": "first"})
	}()
	if oldResource == rg.TokenRequestDuration {
		t.Fatal("resource globals replaced before panic")
	}
}
